l.i: An ut sint lacrymae mea perennes?
Et tu cum his lacrymis soror perennis?

main_text.l: Ὀ Σης Βουδαῖον γλαυκῶς ὀνομάσαντο Φοῖβον Ἀμφοτέρῃ, ἐρθ' ὃ Φοῖβος ἐπὶ μέλλα. Ἀξιος δ' οὐχ εἶ πέμν. μείζων γὰρ ἡ ἡλίου, ὅς θνητοῖς φίλος ἢ καὶ τὰ δύς παρ' ἴχει.
VERO, homines inter splendore aequiq; bonique,
Tote ut regnarent iura sacrata foro,
Stella hac in terras caelo migrare relicto,
Atque hominis faciem sumere iussa fuit:
Sumpsit: sed superas subito remeauit ad oras,
Et nos miramur sublato lumine Legum,
Regnare in medio iurgia sola foro?

page.notes: The Greek epigram is partly illegible in the scan; the Greek line transcribed is a best reading and should be checked against the original. Lines of the Latin verse are copied as printed with long s normalised to s.
